skills.name: Starwild crew and chat
skills.description: Use when a Starwild bot needs to message another player, join or invite someone to a crew, or confirm a crew exists. Covers Nearby vs Crew chat and both invite directions.

skills.name: Starwild climbing and bed spawn
skills.description: Use when a Starwild bot needs to climb a ladder or reach an upper floor, or set a bed as its spawn point.

skills.name: Starwild lag and browser handling
skills.description: Use when a bot plays Starwild in a browser and the game lags, freezes, misses clicks, or loses invites or messages.
